• Let's look at the sentence: "This has been **attributed** to the eating of yams, but the theory is **__________**."
 
• We can say that the implied meaning of the sentence is the eating of yams has been attributed to the birth of twins to the Yoruba people, but the theory is **subjected to disagreement.**
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is "disputed" to make the sentence meaningfully correct.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.
